description: The invalidation history (eleven extra days after 2024-02-02, including a close below DL) scanned at 2024-02-02.
explanation: The scanner reads nothing after as_of (spec 9, D23). The data up to 2024-02-02 is identical to the reference, so every decision (status, candidates, gates, blocked and fresh zones, top-down rows) must equal the reference scan; the later invalidation must not leak backwards.
title: Prefix invariance: appended later candles change nothing at the same as-of
